tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: The cyclorama: behind the 3D viewport, the landing hero, letterbox bars. The deepest ground; never put text-heavy UI straight on it.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Page and app background: launcher, studio shell, docs.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised panels: cards, node bodies, dialogs, inspector, toasts.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Wells and hover: inputs, segmented tracks, meter tracks, a hovered row.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers and quiet panel edges only. Too faint for a control edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control edges: inputs, secondary buttons, unselected cards and ports (3:1 or more on surface-100, 200 and 300 in both themes).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface-000 to surface-300. Bone white on Stage, graphite on Daylight.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata lines, hints and captions on surface-100, 200 and 300 (4.5:1 or more in both themes).

tokens.name: tungsten
tokens.usage: The brand. Fill of the one primary action per view (Generate & play, Play, Publish), the practical-light glow and the cover. Always with on-tungsten text. As a fill only; for tungsten words use tungsten-ink.

tokens.name: tungsten-hover
tokens.usage: Hover state of a tungsten fill.

tokens.name: on-tungsten
tokens.usage: Text and icons on tungsten and tungsten-hover (9:1 or more).

tokens.name: tungsten-ink
tokens.usage: Tungsten as text: an active tab label, a link, the brand word in running copy. On surface-100, 200 and 300 (4.5:1 or more).

tokens.name: peaking
tokens.usage: Focus peaking: the keyboard/gamepad focus ring (2px solid, 2px offset), viewfinder brackets on the selected item, flow ports and wires. Blue against tungsten so the two never read alike. 3:1 or more on every surface; 4.5:1 as text.

tokens.name: tally
tokens.usage: The tally light: live / recording / playing state, damage, low health, destructive actions. Always with a word (LIVE, Delete) or icon. Text-safe on surface-100, 200 and 300.

tokens.name: zebra
tokens.usage: Warnings: over budget, unsaved, low ammo. Pair with the zebra stripe or a word; never alone. Text-safe on surface-100, 200 and 300.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Done: build compiled, world published, objective complete. Teal, off the red–green axis, and lighter than tally on Stage; still pair with a word or icon.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral notices and tips; the same ice as peaking.

tokens.name: on-signal
tokens.usage: Text on a solid peaking, tally, zebra or success fill (a LIVE chip, a port count).

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Behind a dialog or sheet, always together with a depth-far backdrop blur: the world goes out of focus, it does not go dark.

styles.name: title-card
styles.usage: The landing hero and nothing else; one per page, like a film's title card.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Screen titles: the play overlay, a world's page, the result card.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Section heads on the landing page and launcher.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Panel and dialog titles, world names on cards.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Card and panel sub-heads, node titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Pick a world, set a seed, play it in seconds.
styles.usage: Landing and marketing paragraphs; one intro line under a headline.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Activate the control stations. Survive the sentinels.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis and values inside body copy.

styles.name: button
styles.usage: Button and tab labels, in sentence case.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: The lens-metadata line: eyebrows, labels, section markers, key hints. Set in capitals (text-transform: uppercase).

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Project JSON, logs, seeds, performance numbers.

styles.name: hud
styles.usage: In-game counters: ammo, health, score, timers. Tabular by nature.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; bracket arm offset.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap inside a control; metadata separators; port spacing.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Control vertical padding; list-row padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card and node padding; button horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Panel padding; gap between cards.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section gaps inside a screen.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Page gutters on desktop.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between landing sections.

tokens.name: space-9
tokens.usage: Hero breathing room; the height of one focus-pull step on the landing page.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Frames that show the world: viewports, key art, the landing hero. The lens has no rounded corners.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, ports' housings, keyboard hints, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, nodes, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Meters, tally dots, segmented thumbs, round icon buttons.

shadow.note: Depth is carried by blur first (see Depth); shadows stay low and tight.

tokens.name: shadow-edge
tokens.usage: The lit top edge of a raised panel or button: a rim light, not a drop.

tokens.name: shadow-float
tokens.usage: Dialogs, popovers and toasts over the viewport, together with the scrim and a depth-far blur.

tokens.name: shadow-practical
tokens.usage: The practical-light glow on a hovered tungsten button, and on the lit world card on the landing page. Only on tungsten.

depth.note: Blur radii for depth of field. What is not in focus is blurred, not darkened.

tokens.name: depth-near
tokens.usage: One step out of focus: a card behind a hovered card, the foreground layer at rest on the landing page.

tokens.name: depth-mid
tokens.usage: Behind a popover or a docked sheet; mid layers during a focus pull.

tokens.name: depth-far
tokens.usage: Behind a dialog (with the scrim); the far layer of the landing hero.

tokens.name: stroke-hair
tokens.usage: Dividers, card and input edges.

tokens.name: stroke-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, viewfinder bracket arms, the active-tab underline, wires in the blueprint graph.

tokens.name: stroke-icon
tokens.usage: Icon stroke width at 24px (the studio icon set).
